basics.name: Yassine Nachit
basics.label: Postdoctoral researcher
basics.summary: I am a researcher in probability theory, focusing on generalizing some probability aspects from Gaussian to non-Gaussian settings. I am currently a postdoctoral researcher in Professor Ciprian Tudor's group at the University of Lille, working mainly on developing new tools in Malliavin calculus to investigate densities of non-Gaussian processes, Stein method, and local times.
